messages.content: ekta long distance relationship successfully maintain korার jonno realistic weekly structure ki hote pare, bistarito bolo.

Honestly ekta structure thaka actually onek help kore, karon uncertainty kome jai duijon er kacheই। Weekday e ekta short daily check-in rakha valo - shudhu 'kemon acho' na, kichu specific din er ekta detail share kora, jate connection surface-level na thake. Weekend e ekta longer video call plan kora uchit jekhane real conversation howar time thake, shudhu update dewa na. Actually ekta shared activity o try kora jete pare distance sotteo - ekshathe ekta show dekha (screen share kore), ekshathe ekta game khela, eishob chhoto moment gulo shared experience toiri kore। Honestly sobcheye important hocche flexibility rakha ei structure e - jodi kono week e ekta call miss hoy kaj er karone, guilt na kore just next e reschedule kora, rigid rule follow korার cheye relationship ta priority thaka matter kore beshi।
